observed: An overloaded-provider extraction left the projector heartbeat stale and Docker unhealthy because heartbeat writes occurred only after whole batches. Native/MCP and sovereign process remained live.
change: Heartbeat runs on the same asyncio event loop every 30 seconds. Projection phase is separate metadata; counters and last projection time change only through projection results. An actually blocked event loop still becomes stale.

validation.worker_contract: passes: pending await refreshes liveness without changing projection counters/time; blocked event loop becomes unhealthy; stopping ends heartbeats
validation.projection_contract: passes: scope isolation, failure does not advance cursor, resume, stable episode IDs, rebuild isolation
validation.packaged_image: same pending-await/blocked-loop health checks pass with installed smacx-astra-graphiti image
validation.deployment: Only Astra derivative projector replaced; native/MCP/sovereign left running. Fresh heartbeat observed, one projected event, zero failed events at sample.

limits: A fresh heartbeat is event-loop liveness, not proof the provider is making progress.
Full-game acceptance and sustained Graphiti recall usefulness remain ongoing.
